name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Stock Agency for Claude Code: what needs a decision, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: NVDs not in, lots with no result, sales not closed, transfers, vendors to pay, buyers overdue, levy returns.
sections.sql: select reason, ref, coalesce(client, '') as client, detail from v_attention order by severity, reason, ref

sections.title: Coming sales
sections.sql: select s.sale_date as date, s.name as sale, count(c.id) as consignments, coalesce(sum(c.head_booked), 0) as "head booked", count(c.id) filter (where c.nvd_number is null) as "NVDs missing" from sales s left join consignments c on c.sale_id = s.id where s.status = 'booking' and s.sale_date >= agency_today() group by s.id order by s.sale_date

sections.title: Transfers to record
sections.sql: select state, scheme, sale, lot_no as lot, head, vendor_pic as "from", coalesce(buyer_pic, '') as "to", due_on as due from v_transfers where state in ('due', 'overdue') order by due_on

name: money
title: Money in and out
subtitle: Vendor proceeds to pay and buyers who owe

sections.title: Vendor proceeds to pay
sections.sql: select number, vendor, sale, round(net_cents / 100.0, 2) as net, due_on as due, days_late as "days late" from v_settlements where paid_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Buyers owing
sections.sql: select buyer, round(owing_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing, round(overdue_1_14_cents / 100.0, 2) as "1 to 14 days", round(overdue_15_30_cents / 100.0, 2) as "15 to 30 days", round(overdue_30_plus_cents / 100.0, 2) as "over 30 days", round(credit_limit_cents / 100.0, 2) as "limit", coalesce(insured_until::text, '') as "insured until", on_stop as "on stop" from v_debtors order by owing_cents desc

sections.title: Levies held
sections.sql: select to_char(v.month, 'YYYY-MM') as month, v.label, v.head, round(v.levy_cents / 100.0, 2) as levy, coalesce(r.lodged_on::text, 'not lodged') as lodged from v_levies v left join levy_returns r on r.month = v.month order by v.month desc, v.label

name: compliance
title: Compliance
subtitle: The rules in docs/compliance.md checked against the records

sections.title: To act on
sections.sql: select rule, state, item, detail from v_compliance where state <> 'clean' order by case state when 'breached' then 0 else 1 end, rule, item

sections.title: By rule
sections.sql: select rule, count(*) filter (where state = 'clean') as clean, count(*) filter (where state = 'due') as due, count(*) filter (where state = 'breached') as breached from v_compliance group by rule order by rule

name: market
title: Market
subtitle: What each category made at the last six weeks of sales

sections.title: By sale and category
sections.sql: select sale_date as date, sale, category, head, avg_kg as "avg kg", avg_c_per_kg as "avg c/kg", top_c_per_kg as "top c/kg", avg_dollars_per_head as "avg $/hd" from v_market where sale_date >= agency_today() - 42 order by sale_date desc, head desc
